title: Add legal authority and legal instruments to governance guidance
requirements:
- Add institutional and legal preconditions to the starting-point assessment
- Cover duty and right to connect, legal-gap analysis and a legislative roadmap
- Treat privacy, consent, minimisation, purpose limitation and access control as core governance concerns in 3.4
- Score authority to oblige participation separately from technical maturity
- Explain why use-based financing needs a duty to connect
- Consider principles for legal authority, security, data stewardship, conflict of interest and supplier independence
- Include authority among enabling conditions
